questions.prompt: An administrator must protect rg-app against accidental ARM deletion while blocking authorized ARM configuration updates. Sibling resource groups must receive no additional lock restriction. No locks currently apply. Which complete lock configuration meets the requirements?

options.explanation: It blocks deletion in rg-app while permitting authorized updates. Those updates violate the freeze.
It blocks both updates and deletions in rg-app. Sibling groups are outside its scope.
It also restricts sibling groups; it additionally permits the updates the freeze prohibits.
It also restricts sibling groups; the freeze is required only in rg-app.

questions.prompt: A storage account has a ReadOnly management lock. A client is authorized for both a control-plane account configuration update and a data-plane blob overwrite through the Blob service endpoint. Networking permits access and no other protection or restriction applies. Which pair of outcomes follows while the lock remains?

options.text: The account operation is blocked; the blob operation is permitted.
options.explanation: The management lock restricts the control-plane operation, while the authorized Blob-service data operation is outside its scope.

options.text: The account operation and blob operation are both blocked.
options.explanation: The management lock does not restrict the data-plane blob operation.

options.text: The account operation and blob operation are both permitted.
options.explanation: The account control-plane operation is blocked by the effective management lock.

options.text: The account operation is permitted; the blob operation is blocked.
options.explanation: This reverses the operation-plane boundary of the management lock.
